inlines.text: Apple Creator Studio 迎来变革性更新，包括 Final Cut Pro 的内置 MotionVFX 内容、Content Hub 中的视频素材、Logic Pro 扩展的音乐创作工具，以及 Logic Pro、Keynote、Pages 和 Numbers 的全新智能功能。

blocks.text: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺 Apple 今日为 Apple Creator Studio 推出变革性更新。Apple Creator Studio 是一套强大的创意应用集合，旨在将工作室级工具交到 Mac、iPad 和 iPhone 上的现代创作者手中。Mac 版 Final Cut Pro 现内置 MotionVFX——一个包含视觉特效、插件、转场、模板和动态图形工具的丰富集合——并支持在 Pixelmator Pro 中无缝编辑。Apple 精选的 Content Hub 现已包含视频素材，并已在 Final Cut Pro 中提供。使用 Mac 版 Logic Pro 的音乐创作者将获得一个测试版的全新智能助手，1一个增强的 Stem Splitter（现可分离鼓声），以及一个重新设计的浏览器，它整合了所有声音，具备音乐理解能力，甚至包含一个 Splice 库。Pixelmator Pro 推出 Generate Fill，让创作者可以使用自然语言转换图像的选定区域。Keynote、Pages 和 Numbers 推出测试版的全新 AI 功能，包括能够理解文档上下文的助手2，以及用于工作流自动化的全新 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 支持。3它们还在 Content Hub 中新增了库存视频，以及新的高级主题和模板。

blocks.text: “这是自 Apple Creator Studio 推出以来我们最激动人心的一次更新。Final Cut Pro 中的 MotionVFX 内容让订阅用户能够快速获取大量专业视频特效和内容，为整套产品带来巨大价值，”Apple 全球产品营销高级总监（负责应用与 iCloud）Brent Chiu-Watson 表示。“Logic Pro 的全新浏览器让用户在创作音乐时能够探索和尝试比以往更多的声音。Pixelmator Pro 先进的填充功能现在让用户能够完全重新构想图像的任意部分。而 Logic Pro、Keynote、Pages 和 Numbers 中的助手功能将彻底改变人们与这些应用互动并学习使用它们的方式。”

blocks.text: 丰富的新创意工具包与视频工作流

inlines.text: 丰富的新创意工具包与视频工作流

blocks.text: Final Cut Pro 为 Mac 和 iPad 带来了一组卓越的全新功能，面向视频剪辑师、内容创作者和电影制作人，从初出茅庐的故事讲述者到深陷复杂剪辑的资深专业人士皆可受益。Final Cut Pro for Mac 现将 MotionVFX 直接集成到应用中，让剪辑师可以访问数千种元素，包括具有独特主题的模板、时尚的图形、标题和转场，以及用于 rotoscoping、跟踪和调色的工具。剪辑师还可以直接在 Final Cut Pro 内访问 Content Hub，获取 Apple 精选的素材视频、照片和背景库，以填补空缺、增添精致感或激发新想法，而无需离开工作流程。

blocks.text: 跨应用工作流程和视觉创作在 Final Cut Pro 中也实现了重大飞跃。剪辑师可以直接在 Pixelmator Pro 中打开时间线上的任何图像，利用高级编辑工具，并将更改自动保存回项目——无需重新导入。借助高级图像生成功能，用户可以直接在项目中根据文本描述创建令人惊叹的图像、应用快速编辑并调整视觉风格。Final Cut Pro 还引入了强大的工作流程改进，包括更多关键帧缓动选项以实现更精细的动画控制、能够将片段与主故事线断开以将其放置在时间线上的任何位置，以及 23 种新的转录语言，使添加字幕和搜索素材比以往任何时候都更容易。

blocks.text: Motion 还内置了一组强大的 MotionVFX 插件，用于电影级调色、3D 摄像机跟踪，以及一键选取以打造惊艳的视觉效果。用户现在可以根据文字描述生成和编辑图像，将图像往返发送至 Pixelmator Pro，微调关键帧缓动，应用全新的 Displacement 滤镜，并探索交互式演示项目。此外，Compressor 新增了对在 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone Duo 上录制的 Cinematic 模式视频进行编码的功能。

blocks.text: 重新构想的图像编辑

inlines.text: 重新构想的图像编辑

blocks.text: Pixelmator Pro 推出 Generate Fill，这是一款强大的新工具，可根据用户的描述编辑图像。创作者只需在图像中圈出某个区域，并描述他们想要的更改。如需更高精度，创作者可以使用 Pixelmator Pro 现有的选择工具，例如 Free Selection、Quick Selection 或 Magnetic Selection。Generate Fill 会自动匹配周围环境的光照、透视和纹理，使编辑内容无缝融入，而内置的 Super Resolution 会对生成的内容进行放大，使其在任何尺寸下都保持清晰。生成的元素可以合并到现有图层中，或作为新图层插入，并带有智能蒙版，以便继续精修。

blocks.text: 用应用内智能提升生产力

inlines.text: 用应用内智能提升生产力

blocks.text: 可视化生产力应用为订阅用户带来新一代智能功能，包括直接内置于 Keynote、Pages 和 Numbers 中、基于 Apple 模型和 OpenAI 构建的智能助手。该助手能理解文档上下文，帮助用户无需离开工作即可完成更多任务。² 在 Keynote 中，智能助手可协助设计、制作动画和优化幻灯片。在 Pages 中，它可起草、重构和微调书面内容。在 Numbers 中，它可计算、可视化和整理数据；通过一键预览推荐合适的图表类型；并利用世界知识构建自定义表格。基于该平台构建的全新 MCP 支持使外部 AI 代理和工具能够直接在 Keynote、Pages 和 Numbers 中读取内容、执行编辑并执行自动化操作。

blocks.text: Updates bring built-in MotionVFX content to Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, expanded music creation tools to Logic Pro, and new intelligence features to Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers

inlines.text: Updates bring built-in MotionVFX content to Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, expanded music creation tools to Logic Pro, and new intelligence features to Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers

blocks.text: Apple Creator Studio gets transformative updates, including built-in MotionVFX content for Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, expanded music creation tools in Logic Pro, and new intelligence features in Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.

inlines.text: Apple Creator Studio gets transformative updates, including built-in MotionVFX content for Final Cut Pro, video assets in the Content Hub, expanded music creation tools in Logic Pro, and new intelligence features in Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.

blocks.text: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced transformative updates to Apple Creator Studio, the powerful collection of creative apps designed to put studio-grade tools into the hands of modern creators across Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Final Cut Pro for Mac now includes built-in MotionVFX — an expansive collection of visual effects, plug-ins, transitions, templates, and motion graphics tools — as well as seamless editing in Pixelmator Pro. Apple’s curated Content Hub now includes video assets and is available in Final Cut Pro. Music creators using Logic Pro for Mac gain a new intelligent assistant in beta,1 an enhanced Stem Splitter that now separates drums, and a redesigned Browser that incorporates all sounds, with music understanding and even a Splice library. Pixelmator Pro introduces Generate Fill, which lets creators transform selected areas of an image using natural language. Keynote, Pages, and Numbers introduce new AI features in beta, including assistants2 that understand document context and new Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for workflow automation.3 They also add stock video in the Content Hub and new premium themes and templates.

Pixelmator Pro introduces Generate Fill, which lets creators transform selected areas of an image using natural language. Keynote, Pages, and Numbers introduce new AI features in beta, including assistants2 that understand document context and new Model Context Protocol (MCP) support for workflow automation.3 They also add stock video in the Content Hub and new premium themes and templates.

blocks.text: “This is our most exciting update since the launch of Apple Creator Studio. MotionVFX content in Final Cut Pro gives subscribers rapid access to extensive professional video effects and content, bringing incredible value to the suite,” said Brent Chiu-Watson, Apple’s senior director of Worldwide Product Marketing for Apps and iCloud. “Logic Pro’s new Browser allows users to explore and experiment with more sounds than ever as they create music. Pixelmator Pro’s sophisticated fill capabilities now let users completely reimagine any part of an image. And the assistant capabilities in Logic Pro, Keynote, Pages, and Numbers are going to change the game for how people interact with and learn to use these apps.”

blocks.text: Expansive New Creative Toolkits and Video Workflows

inlines.text: Expansive New Creative Toolkits and Video Workflows

blocks.text: Final Cut Pro for Mac and iPad delivers an exceptional set of new capabilities for video editors, content creators, and filmmakers, from emerging storytellers to seasoned professionals deep in complex edits. Final Cut Pro for Mac now integrates MotionVFX directly into the app, giving editors access to thousands of elements, including templates with unique themes, stylish graphics, titles, and transitions, as well as tools for rotoscoping, tracking, and color grading. Editors can also tap into the Content Hub directly within Final Cut Pro and access a library of Apple-curated stock videos, photos, and backgrounds to fill gaps, add polish, or spark new ideas without leaving their workflow.

blocks.text: Cross-app workflows and visual creation also take a major leap forward in Final Cut Pro. Editors can open any image from their timeline directly in Pixelmator Pro, take advantage of advanced editing tools, and save changes back to the project automatically — no reimporting required. With advanced image generation, users can create stunning images from text descriptions right inside their project, apply quick edits, and adjust visual styles. And Final Cut Pro introduces powerful workflow improvements, including more keyframe easing options for finer animation control, the ability to disconnect clips from the primary storyline to place them anywhere on the timeline, and 23 new transcription languages, making it easier than ever to caption and search footage.

blocks.text: Reimagined Image Editing

inlines.text: Reimagined Image Editing

blocks.text: Pixelmator Pro introduces Generate Fill, a powerful new tool to edit images based on a user’s description. Creators can simply circle an area in an image and describe the change they want. For more precision, creators can use existing Pixelmator Pro selection tools, like Free Selection, Quick Selection, or Magnetic Selection. Generate Fill automatically matches the lighting, perspective, and texture of the surrounding environment so edits blend in seamlessly, while built-in Super Resolution upscales the generated content so it stays sharp at any size. Generated elements can be merged into existing layers or inserted as new layers with intelligent masking that allows for continued refinement.

blocks.text: Powering Productivity with In-App Intelligence

inlines.text: Powering Productivity with In-App Intelligence

blocks.text: Visual productivity apps receive a new generation of intelligence features for subscribers, including an intelligent assistant, built on Apple models and OpenAI, directly within Keynote, Pages, and Numbers. The assistant understands document context to help users accomplish more without leaving their work.² In Keynote, the intelligent assistant helps with designing, animating, and refining slides. In Pages, it drafts, restructures, and fine-tunes written content. In Numbers, it calculates, visualizes, and organizes data; recommends suitable chart types with a one-tap preview; and builds custom tables using world knowledge. New MCP support, built on this platform, enables external AI agents and tools to read content, perform edits, and execute automated actions directly in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers.

blocks.text: Across Keynote, Pages, and Numbers, the Content Hub expands to include Apple-curated stock video footage, giving creators dynamic visuals to enhance presentations, reports, and spreadsheets. Subscribers also gain access to a fresh collection of professionally designed templates and themes. Keynote introduces support for Keynote Interchange Format (.keyx), an open JSON-based bundle file format designed to be readable and accessible to external tools, developer workflows, and AI agents.

blocks.text: Freeform adds text styles for one-step formatting and reuse across boards, custom and preset board background colors, and, arriving in December, the ability to edit images directly in Pixelmator Pro and generate editable shapes from text descriptions.

The assistant (beta) in Logic Pro for Mac requires macOS 27 Golden Gate or later on an Apple Intelligence-capable Mac and is available in U.S. English only.
The assistant (beta) in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers requires an Apple Intelligence-capable device running iOS 27, iPadOS 27, or macOS 27 or later, and is available in U.S. English only.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Keynote, Pages, and Numbers requires macOS 27 or later.

The Apple Creator Studio version of Final Cut Pro for Mac requires macOS 26.6 or later and a Mac with Intel or Apple silicon (some features require Apple silicon). Final Cut Pro for iPad requires iPadOS 26.6 or later and an iPad with an A16, A17 Pro, or M1 chip or later. Final Cut Camera requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 26.6 or iPadOS 26.6 or later. Logic Pro for Mac requires macOS 26.1 or later and a Mac with Apple silicon. Logic Pro for iPad requires iPadOS 26 or later and an iPad with an Apple A12 Bionic chip or later. Pixelmator Pro requires macOS 26 or later for Mac (Intel or Apple silicon; some features require Apple silicon) and iPadOS 26 or later for iPad (A16, A17 Pro, or M1 chip or later). Motion requires macOS 15.6 or later. Compressor requires macOS 15.6 or later and a Mac with Intel or Apple silicon (Apple Immersive Video processing requires 32GB of RAM, with 64GB and storage read speeds of 2,000MB/s or faster recommended; some features require Apple silicon). Keynote, Pages, Numbers, and Freeform require macOS 26, iOS 26, or iPadOS 26 or later.

Available to new and qualified returning subscribers who purchase a new Mac or qualifying iPad from Apple or an Apple Authorized Reseller. iPad must have at least 6GB of memory and an A16, A17 Pro, or M-series chip or later. Plan renews at $12.99 per month or $129 per year based on the plan selected. Only one offer per Apple Account and only one offer per family if they’re part of a Family Sharing group, regardless of the number of devices that they or their family purchase. This offer is not available if the account holder or their family has previously accepted an Apple Creator Studio subscription three-months-free offer. Offer good for three months after eligible device activation. Plan automatically renews until cancelled. Restrictions and other terms apply.

New subscribers only. Education Savings Plan automatically renews at $2.99 per month or $29.99 per year based on the plan selected, until cancelled. Offer good for college students and educators only and does not extend to a Family Sharing group. Verification required. Terms apply. Limited-time offer; offer may end at any time.

The one-time-purchase version of Final Cut Pro requires macOS 26.6 or later, Logic Pro requires macOS 26.1 or later, and Pixelmator Pro requires macOS 26 or later. MainStage requires macOS 15.6 or later and a Mac with Apple silicon. Motion requires macOS 15.6 or later. Compressor requires macOS 15.6 or later, and some features require a Mac with Apple silicon.
